messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old"
set: ["for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old", "adults and children who are at least 6 years old", "asthma attacks in adults and children at least 2 years old", "anxiety in adults and children at least 7 years old", "children at least 10 years old", "adults and children at least 2 years old with symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis", "at least 6 years old", "major depressive disorder in adults and adolescents at least 12 years old", "children younger than 2 years old", "children 4 years old and older", "children 5 years old and older", "type 2 diabetes in adults and children aged 10 years and older", "avoid use in children younger than 12 years old", "adults and children 3 years and older", "adults and children", "treatment for at least 5 days in children"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
